selection_rationale: Localization, settled-fill/empty stop and return conditions passed all development scenes. Retain the documented small spill failure and measure residual spill risk in the unchanged strict thirty-case evaluation.
test_policy: 30 once after final selection, 15 full/15 empty, no fitting or tuning during tests
primary_definition: Sustained verified grasp, final rim height>=90% or source<=max(.25 nominal mL,1% initial), correct reason, completed return/release, zero final outside particles and none ever below cup-frame z=3.5mm
legacy_definition: Original >=90% nominal brim inventory score retained separately
volume_units: Nominal particle-count mL, not calibrated physical volume
